ANALYSIS
domain: automotive dealership and repair services
tone: trustworthy, professional expert, client-oriented
visual_density: balanced

COMPOSITION
The page contains an intro, 5 thematic sections, and an FAQ block. With 7 available template slots (Hero, Stats, Features, Content-Image, Banner, Testimonial, CTA), we map the intro to Hero, repurpose Stats for quantitative key facts (30+ years, multibrand inspection), use Features and Content-Image for core selling propositions, place the transition to new cars in Banner, and adapt Testimonial/CTA for credibility and the final FAQ/contact close. Splitting the dense multibrand VO section allows clean distribution across Stats and Features while maintaining structural and visual rhythm.

NOTES
- Split "Un stock VO..." before the H3s: part 1 highlights garage heritage and metrics in [1] stats (overflow), while the two H3s ("Renault et Dacia", "Toutes les autres marques") integrate seamlessly into [2] features columns.
